release_title: A new era of intelligence with Gemini 3

models.name: Gemini 3 Pro
models.capability_summary: Gemini 3 发布以「智能新纪元」为题呈现，Gemini 3 Pro 为旗舰型号（发布时 preview）。已收录评测横跨推理、代码、多模态与 Agent：亮点 LMArena 1501 Elo、AIME 2025（带代码执行）100%。

models.name: Gemini 3 Deep Think
models.variant: enhanced reasoning mode; safety-tester access at launch
models.capability_summary: Gemini 3 Deep Think 为 Gemini 3 的增强推理模式，发布时访问仅限安全测试者。已收录 3 项页面文本评测：亮点 ARC-AGI-2（ARC Prize Verified）45.1%、GPQA Diamond 93.8%。

'Significantly outperforms 2.5 Pro on every major AI benchmark' is a relative claim without printed numbers (SWE-bench Verified table shows Claude Sonnet 4.5 77.2% above Gemini 3 Pro 76.2% — the page bolds the competitor cell).
